segments.normalizedSource: ```swift import SwiftUI import TipKit // Define your tip's content. struct FavoriteLandmarkTip: Tip { var title: Text { Text("Save as a Favorite") } var message: Text? { Text("Your favorite landmarks always appear at the top of the list.") } var image: Image? { Image(systemName: "star") } } @main struct LandmarkTips: App { // Create an instance of your tip. var favoriteLandmarkTip = FavoriteLandmarkTip() var body: some Scene { WindowGroup { VStack { // Place the tip view near the feature you want to highlight. TipView(favoriteLandmarkTip, arrowEdge: .bottom) Image(systemName: "star") .imageScale(.large) Spacer() } .task { // Configure and load your tips at app launch. do { try Tips.configure() } catch { // Handle TipKit errors print("Error initializing TipKit \(error.localizedDescription)") } } } } } ```
